_comment: The font-size a fit-to-width line carries (#358). buildFitFontSize() in blocks/typography-stylist/utils.js writes it and Typost::add_fit_line_plain_properties() in typography-stylist.php reads the line ratio back out of it at render time (#315). Read by blocks/typography-stylist/__tests__/css-js-mirrors.test.js (args -> fontSize) and tests/Unit/FitLineSizesFixtureTest.php (fontSize -> ratio), so a change to how the block writes a line that the filter cannot read fails one of them.
